text:
samir: Cutover window today 23:00 UTC for catalog v3-alpha enable. Locking pinlist. @lina can you confirm telemetry hooks and fallback ordering? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary at 23:00 UTC (will be 5% traffic). Runbook: https://runbook.internal/release-catalog-v3-alpha. Use `deploybot --canary 5 --duration 20m`.

lina: Telemetry hooks in place (traces + slo logs). Dashboards wired to the rollout tag. Suggest pin v3-alpha at 5% for canary, keep v2 as primary. Fallback order proposal: v2 -> v1-quant -> v1.

marco: Ops: reserving extra capacity in us-west1 for the window, bumped dedicated pool +10%. Will monitor memory and queue depth.

qa-bot: preflight checks: latency ✅, throughput ✅, correctness evals mostly green. Note: rerank test flaky on long prompts (2/20 failures).

samir: Hmm the rerank flakiness worries me. Can we hold the canary for 30m until we investigate? Prefer to delay rather than roll forward with a regression.

lina: agree, delay sounds prudent. I'll run a focused rerank sweep now and patch if needed. Update the deploy plan to 23:30 UTC.

ops-oncall: OK to shift +30m. I'll keep capacity reserved and watch the error budget. Auto-rollback if error rate > 3% for 5m.

samir: I updated the pinlist and rollback policy: immediate auto-rollback on >3% errors; fallback ladder set. Patch applied to catalog config.

samir: (patch excerpt)
```
fallback_order:
  - v3-alpha
  - v2
  - v1-quant
  - v1
auto_rollback_threshold: 0.03
canary_traffic_percent: 5
canary_duration: 20m
```

deploy-bot: schedule updated. Canary now at 23:30 UTC, 5% traffic, 20m duration. Auto-rollback thresholds configured.

marco: I'll draft the release-note snippet: "Catalog v3-alpha canary 5% -> fallback order v2, v1-quant, v1. Auto-rollback on >3% errors. Extra capacity reserved in us-west1."

lina: Adding telemetry dashboard link to notes and the quick error query: `sum(rate(api_errors[1m])) / sum(rate(api_requests[1m]))` tagged by rollout.

samir: Great. I'll be on call for the cutover. If you see anything odd ping @samir and run the rollback playbook in the runbook link. :thumbsup:

qa-bot: after rerank sweep: 20/20 passing. Canary delay cleared.

marco: release note ready, posting to release channel at T-15m.

deploy-bot: final confirmation queued. Canary start: 5076545400 (23:30 UTC). Good luck everyone! :rocket:
